## Active

### D-098 — blong-lint is a package because a realm cannot depend on a tool

> _2026-09-12 · core/blong-lint · active_

Both the CLI and the runtime API need the same tsc, cspell and eslint pipeline, so the code could
not live inside `blong-dev`. The CLI keeps its own dependency copies and passes its bin directory
in, while the package also resolves its own `node_modules/.bin` so it works from the runtime with no
PATH setup.

### D-141 — The lint cycle broke by giving blong-lint its own entry points

> _2026-09-12 · core/blong-lint · active_

pnpm 10.33.2, the version `rush.json` pins, reported a cyclic workspace dependency between
`core/blong-lint` and `tools/blong-dev`: `blong-dev` depends on `blong-lint` for its `lint` command,
and `blong-lint` had `blong-dev` as a devDependency only so its scripts could call `blong-dev lint`
and `blong-dev test`. The chosen direction is that a library must not depend on the tool that
consumes it, so the `blong-lint` to `blong-dev` edge was removed instead of the other one:
`formatDiagnostic` moved from `blong-dev/src/commands/lint.ts` into blong-lint's `index.ts` (it
renders a `Diagnostic` the package already owns), a new `blong-lint/cli.ts` exports
`lintCli(files, {cwd, binPaths})`, a new `blong-lint/bin/lint.ts` calls it on its own package root
so `ci-lint` lints the folder it lives in rather than the CWD, and `blong-dev/src/commands/lint.ts`
became a one-line delegate that still prefers its own bundled cspell, eslint and tsc. `ci-test`
became a bare tap invocation and, as a follow-up, `blong-lint/bin/test.ts` which also performs the
`.tap/coverage` cleanup that `blong-dev test` used to do. Verified: `rush update` no longer warns,
both lints report clean, and `tsc --noEmit` in blong-dev passes. Unchanged and pre-existing:
`core/blong-lint` has no test files, so its `ci-test` exits 1, exactly as the old `blong-dev test`
did.
